title: Sense and Avoid
subtitle: Use sensors to dodge debris
description: Cross the damaged Sector 2 estate, work around fallen debris and reach the stranded resident marker.
story: Sector 2 is an older estate with narrow service lanes. Overnight winds brought down trees and scaffolding. Nothing is on fire, nobody is hurt — but the lanes are blocked, and Command needs to know which routes are still usable.
learningObjectives: A distance sensor measures how far away the next object is
A threshold turns a measurement into a decision
Reactive programming means responding to what you sense right now
Sensor readings are noisy, so thresholds need a safety margin

objectives.description: Reach the resident marker in the south-east corner

failureConditions.message: The battery ran flat somewhere in the estate.
Time ran out before the rover crossed the estate.
The rover crashed too many times and was recalled for repairs.

hints: Turning when the distance reading is below 2 gives the rover more room than waiting until it is below 1.
If the rover keeps spinning on the spot, two of your rules are probably fighting. Use Step mode to watch one decision at a time.
The blue tiles are flood water. They are passable, but they cost double energy and hurt your safety score.
All-terrain wheels slip much less on wet ground, but they are slower and heavier.
reflectionQuestions: What threshold did you choose for your distance rule, and how did you decide?
What did the rover do when the sensor reading was noisy?
Did adding a second sensor help? Was it worth the budget?
